components.text: Only with Great Sage, and only when Great Sage itself opens the road to Raphael: until then the rite is closed. A witch-type performer, at a lunar eclipse, works it for the one on the circle, or for herself.

They must hold Great Sage and Degenerate, both mastered, and agree by sneaking. Great Sage's own requirements still decide. If FoxAblaze is there, the Raphael is FoxAblaze's, and only one player can own it.
Costs rare items and altar power. The two skills are the price: they are taken once Raphael is learned.
An eclipse happens on some full-moon nights (the server's chance). It lasts until dawn, and an eclipse also counts as a full moon for every rite that needs one.
